'''Nuth''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]]. The local [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] had razed the city to the ground for supporting local rebellious activists several years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
